en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning issued as temperatures hit 33C
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory posted the warning at 2:15pm, advising the public to guard against heat stroke amid afternoon temperatures around 33 degrees.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 2:15pm on Monday, warning that very hot conditions were expected across the territory.
At 2pm the Observatory recorded 33 degrees Celsius with relative humidity of 60 per cent. The mean ultraviolet index at King's Park over the previous hour stood at 7, rated high.

The Observatory advised the public to beware of heat stroke. Elderly people, pregnant women, infants and children, those with chronic illnesses such as heart disease or high blood pressure, and the obese are more vulnerable and should watch for symptoms.

People working outdoors or in high-temperature environments were urged to follow Labour Department guidance on preventing heat stroke. Outdoor activities should preferably be scheduled for the morning or later afternoon, with plenty of water and rest in shaded areas if feeling unwell.

zh.headline: 天文台發出酷熱天氣警告 氣溫達33度
zh.dek: 天文台於下午2時15分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日天氣酷熱，市民應慎防中暑。
body: 香港天文台於星期一下午2時15分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日本港天氣酷熱。
下午2時天文台錄得氣溫33度，相對濕度百分之60。京士柏過去一小時平均紫外線指數為7，強度屬高。
天文台提醒市民慎防中暑。長者、孕婦、嬰兒及小童、慢性病如心臟病或高血壓患者，以及過胖人士較易中暑，應及時觀察是否出現中暑徵兆。
在炎熱天氣下或高溫環境中工作的人士，應參照勞工處預防工作時中暑指引採取措施。戶外活動宜安排在早上或下午較後時間進行，並多補充水分，如感不適應盡快到陰涼地方休息。
